notes.title: Beta continues, Gold approaches!
notes.content:
Sup. The game has definitely been on a roll since the last announcement.

We have had many alpha and beta testers go through FRENZY and are still receiving feedback on it now. We recently had a special stream showing the game, fan art from all of you guys, and a Q&A session with me and my team including Sheen and Fatigue's voice actor.

That being said I will be updating ya'll on where the game stands right now in development.

+UPDATES+

- Cut scenes for both Sheen and Fatigue's story are 70% completed.

- Dialogue for the game itself including cut scenes, in game, combo alerts, and mini games are 90% done.

- Art assets are about 95% done and in the current working game build.

- 5 bosses (4 mini and 1 final) in development are at 80% completion.

- Local Co-op is now in the game and is at 75% completion.

- The Soundtrack is fully compiled with a total of 12 tracks. 100%

- Mini-games are functional but going through extensive bug testing leaving it at 90% completion.

- Power ups and bonuses are functional and going through the final touches at 90% completion.

- Leader boards are at 90% completion.

- Unlockables screen now added to main menu.

- All 10 unique levels function properly and are in the game. 100% completed.

- Updated GUI for story and multiplayer.

Id like to have everything around 95% completion or higher on release day. After that patches, updates will be added weekly. Once everything is polished more game content and additions will be added to the game will continue until sales stop.

Thank you all so much for the support! For the beta testers, for suggestions, for all of you who got your 400 BETA keys, for all the fan art you send, and trash ❤️ , as well as the haters! Ya'll keep me going! Lets make it to release day! See you guys next update! >:(

-Kris
